newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares extend gains, hit fresh late record.
newsitem.headline: German shares extend gains, hit fresh late record.

text.p: 1452 GMT - German shares extend gains in late electronic trade, shrugging off sluggish start on Wall Street as liquidity conditions remain good and bank shares remain in demand. Dealers see little downward risk as end of second quarter approaches, market cheered by clear breach of psychologically key 3,800 DAX point level.
* IBIS DAX index up 58.80 points at 3,819.87 points, hit intraday record high of 3,820.94.
* September DTB DAX future up 65 at 3,845.
* Bank remain among top performers after technically driven surge in Deutsche Bank AG.
